checks.name: CS2 worker survives control and media queue overflow
command:
import json, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

package = './pkg/xiaomi/miss/cs2'
with TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    test = Path(directory) / 'patchset_queue_overflow_test.go'
    test.write_text('\n'.join(sys.argv[1:]) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    overlay = test.with_suffix('.json')
    virtual = Path(package).resolve() / test.name
    overlay.write_text(json.dumps({'Replace': {str(virtual): str(test)}}), encoding='utf-8')
    result = subprocess.run(['go', 'test', '-mod=readonly', '-count=1', '-timeout=15s', '-v', '-run', '^TestPatchsetQueueOverflow$', '-overlay', str(overlay), package], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
    print(result.stdout, end='')
    result.check_returncode()
    if not any(line.startswith('--- PASS: TestPatchsetQueueOverflow ') for line in result.stdout.splitlines()):
        sys.exit('The CS2 overflow test did not run and pass')
